The '''''Bhishana Bhaga''''' was a [[guardian corvette]] used as mobile base of operations by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] for [[Min Erethen]], one of its key researchers. At its center was ''[[Sanctum Sanctorum]]'', a modified [[A4 Juggernaut]] used by Erethen as a research lab. To keep its precious cargo safe, Arakyd referred to the ship only by a variable codename and kept it mobile across the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. While under the codename '''''Bloodhawk''''', the ''Bhishana Bhaga''{{'s}} [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] failed, dropping the ship into an asteroid field. The battered corvette crashed on nearby [[Krykas V]], spreading its wreckage across 300 meters before resting in a valley.
